resources.string: Pick a day and a time
What do you want to talk about?
No free times in the next %1$d days for this length. Try another length.
Times are shown on your phone\'s clock.
Tell them what you need, so they come ready (at least 10 letters)
Phone numbers, emails and links are not allowed — everything stays inside Dorr.
You pay now from your wallet; Dorr holds the money until after the session.
This is a request: the time is yours once the freelancer accepts. If they decline or do not answer within %1$d hours, you get everything back.
Cancel %1$d hours or more before and you get everything back. If the freelancer cancels, you always get everything back.
If something goes wrong, report it within %1$d hours after the session and Dorr steps in.
The total is held from your wallet now. The freelancer then accepts or declines.
Safe: the money stays held by Dorr, and you get it all back if they decline or do not answer in %1$d hours.
Request sent. You will be told when the freelancer answers.
Open a freelancer\'s profile or service and book a consultation with them.
You get all %1$s back in your wallet at once.
It is less than %1$d hours before the start, so the money goes to the freelancer and is not given back.
The freelancer is paid now. You can no longer report a problem afterwards.
Thank you — the freelancer was paid
The money stays held while the Dorr team looks at what happened and tells you both.
e.g. the freelancer did not join the call, or it was not what was booked
Nothing is paid to the freelancer until a decision is made.
Sent. We will look at it.
Waiting for %1$s\'s answer (by %2$s). Your money is held and you can withdraw the request any time for everything back. You will be told when they answer.
The freelancer could not take this time; all your money is back in your wallet. Pick another time.
The freelancer did not answer in time, so the request was cancelled and all your money is back in your wallet.
The freelancer accepted another request for this time; all your money is back in your wallet. Pick another time.
Free cancellation until %1$s. The session is a video call; it opens here at the time.
Less than a day to go: cancelling now does not give the money back.
It is time. The video call starts here soon.
If you say nothing, the freelancer is paid on %1$s. Something wrong? Report it before then.
Your report is with the Dorr team; the money stays held until they decide.
After looking at your report, all your money went back to your wallet.
You cancelled it in time and got your money back.
You cancelled late, so the money went to the freelancer.
The freelancer cancelled it; all your money is back in your wallet.
Search a consultation or a freelancer
Paid consultations are not available in your country right now.
When freelancers list consultations they show here. Try another word.
How was the session with %1$s? Your stars show on their profile at once.
Thanks, the freelancer got your rating.
It shows on the freelancer\'s profile.
